inputs.text: A young woman with long, dark brown wavy hair cascading over her right shoulder gazes directly at the viewer with a neutral to slightly pensive expression, her lips softly parted and eyes accentuated by defined eyeliner. She wears a simple white spaghetti strap top featuring thin straps that converge into a V-neckline near her collarbone, complemented by small pearl-like stud earrings on both ears. Her posture is upright but relaxed as she sits or stands facing forward in front of a plain, muted gray backdrop which appears studio-lit and intentionally blurred behind her shoulders. The scene suggests an indoor setting like a photo shoot room or dressing area due to its controlled ambiance and lack of distracting environmental features. Lighting originates from the front-left side, casting even illumination across her face while creating gentle highlights along her cheekbones and forehead without harsh shadows — suggesting diffused artificial light typical for portrait photography. Shot from eye level using a medium close-up framing, the focus remains sharply concentrated on her upper body and face, subtly drawing attention to her direct gaze and elegant attire against the minimalist background.
